title: Add farmer's carries and dead hangs weekly.
subtitle: Grip and carry strength
rationale: Grip strength is among the strongest physical mortality markers; carries and hangs train it plus shoulders and trunk.

evidence.summary: The grip-mortality association is robust and dose-dependent in cohorts; that training grip moves outcomes is extrapolation from the marker.

sources.label: Grip strength and mortality PURE cohort

indications: Strength sessions skip carries and hangs entirely.
Grip fails before the rest of the body on big lifts.
